description: Flat metadata schema for individual fungal biosynthetic gene cluster records, including genome sequencing, cluster annotation, and linked secondary metabolite characterization.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record representing one fungal biosynthetic gene cluster or linked gene-level annotation record. Example: FUNG-BGC-0001.

fungal_isolate_id.descr: Identifier for the fungal isolate or strain from which the DNA and metabolites were obtained. Example: isolate code or strain number.

organism_scientific_name.descr: Accepted scientific name of the fungal organism, including genus and species when available. Example: Aspergillus nidulans.

organism_taxonomy_id.descr: External taxonomy identifier for the fungus, if available. Example: NCBI Taxonomy ID.

taxonomic_family.descr: Taxonomic family of the fungal organism.

taxonomic_order.descr: Taxonomic order of the fungal organism.

taxonomic_class.descr: Taxonomic class of the fungal organism.

sample_source.descr: Origin of the fungal sample or isolate. Example values: soil, endophyte, marine sponge, decaying wood, clinical isolate, culture collection.

sample_geographic_location.descr: Geographic origin of the sample, preferably in a standardized place name or coordinates-as-text format. Example: Costa Rica, Guanacaste.

sample_collection_date.descr: Date the biological sample or isolate was collected, if known, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

culture_condition.descr: Growth medium and/or cultivation conditions used before DNA extraction or metabolite production. Example: potato dextrose broth, 28 C, 120 rpm, 7 days.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Protocol or kit used to extract fungal DNA. Include kit name or key reagents when possible.

dna_quality_metric.descr: Measure of DNA quality, purity, or integrity. Example: A260/280 ratio, DIN, or gel quality summary.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing technology used to generate the genome data. Example: Illumina NovaSeq, PacBio Sequel II, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_library_strategy.descr: Library preparation or sequencing strategy. Example: paired-end WGS, long-read WGS, hybrid sequencing.

sequencing_read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for the sequencing data, if applicable. For paired-end data, this may be the per-read length.

sequencing_coverage_x.descr: Approximate genome sequencing depth in fold coverage (X). Example: 80.5.

genome_assembly_accession.descr: Public or internal accession for the genome assembly used to identify the cluster, if available.

assembly_contig_id.descr: Contig/scaffold identifier containing the biosynthetic gene cluster.

cluster_start_bp.descr: Genomic start coordinate of the biosynthetic gene cluster on the contig/scaffold, in base pairs.

cluster_end_bp.descr: Genomic end coordinate of the biosynthetic gene cluster on the contig/scaffold, in base pairs.

cluster_length_bp.descr: Total length of the biosynthetic gene cluster region in base pairs.

cluster_detection_method.descr: Tool or approach used to detect the biosynthetic gene cluster. Example: antiSMASH, DeepBGC, manual curation.

cluster_detection_version.descr: Version of the cluster detection software or pipeline.

cluster_class.descr: Major biosynthetic class of the cluster. Example values: NRPS, PKS, terpene, hybrid PKS-NRPS, RiPP, siderophore, indole, lanthipeptide.

cluster_product_family.descr: Predicted or known metabolite family associated with the cluster. Example: polyketide, nonribosomal peptide, terpenoid, alkaloid.

cluster_completeness.descr: Assessment of whether the cluster appears complete in the assembly. Example values: complete, partial, fragmented.

cluster_confidence_score.descr: Confidence score for the cluster prediction or annotation, if provided by the analysis pipeline. Use the pipeline's native scale.

cluster_number_of_genes.descr: Number of predicted genes within the biosynthetic gene cluster region.

cluster_regulatory_genes_present.descr: Whether known regulatory genes are present within the cluster boundary.

cluster_transport_genes_present.descr: Whether transport or efflux genes are present within the cluster boundary.

gene_id.descr: Identifier of the gene within the cluster. Example: gene1, AN1234, or locus tag.

gene_locus_tag.descr: Genome annotation locus tag for the gene, if available.

gene_product_annotation.descr: Predicted function or protein product annotation for the gene. Example: ketosynthase, adenylation enzyme, cytochrome P450.

gene_enzymatic_role.descr: Role of the gene product in the biosynthetic pathway. Example values: core enzyme, tailoring enzyme, transporter, regulator, resistance protein.

gene_ec_number.descr: Enzyme Commission number for the gene product, if assigned.

gene_domain_architecture.descr: Domain composition of the encoded protein, if relevant. Example: KS-AT-DH-ER or A-T-C.

gene_orientation.descr: Strand orientation of the gene relative to the reference assembly. Example values: forward, reverse.

gene_start_bp.descr: Genomic start coordinate of the gene on the contig/scaffold, in base pairs.

gene_end_bp.descr: Genomic end coordinate of the gene on the contig/scaffold, in base pairs.

gene_expression_evidence.descr: Whether transcriptomic or proteomic evidence supports expression of the gene. Example values: yes/no or a short evidence summary.

metabolite_isolation_id.descr: Identifier for the isolated metabolite linked to this cluster, if available. Example: M001.

metabolite_name.descr: Common or proposed name of the isolated secondary metabolite.

metabolite_molecular_formula.descr: Molecular formula determined from chemistry analysis, if known. Example: C20H28O5.

metabolite_exact_mass_da.descr: Measured or calculated exact mass of the metabolite in Daltons (Da).

metabolite_mz.descr: Observed mass-to-charge ratio used for identification, if applicable.

metabolite_retention_time_min.descr: Chromatographic retention time in minutes, if measured.

metabolite_isolation_method.descr: Method used to isolate the metabolite from fungal culture. Example: solvent extraction, HPLC fractionation, SPE.

metabolite_analytical_method.descr: Analytical chemistry method used to characterize the metabolite. Example: LC-MS/MS, NMR, GC-MS, HRMS.

metabolite_structure_determined.descr: Whether the metabolite structure was experimentally confirmed. Example: true for fully elucidated structures.

metabolite_bioactivity_assay.descr: Assay used to test biological or industrially relevant activity. Example: antibacterial, antifungal, cytotoxicity, enzyme inhibition.

metabolite_bioactivity_result.descr: Outcome of the bioactivity assay. Example: active, inactive, moderate activity, or a short quantitative summary.

metabolite_potential_application.descr: Potential industrial or applied use suggested by the study. Example: pharmaceutical lead, agrochemical, enzyme inhibitor, pigment, food additive.

cluster_metabolite_link_evidence.descr: Evidence supporting the link between the gene cluster and the metabolite. Example: gene knockout, coexpression, isotope feeding, correlation, heterologous expression.

biosynthetic_pathway_summary.descr: Free-text summary of the inferred biosynthetic pathway and gene-level roles in the cluster.

manual_curation_status.descr: Whether the record has been manually reviewed and curated by an expert. Example values: true/false.

record_creation_date.descr: Date the metadata record was created or last updated, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
